def load_json(path: Path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def assert_protected() -> dict[str, str]:
    actual = {path: sha256(SUB / path) for path in PROTECTED_SHA256}
    mismatches = {
        path: {"expected": PROTECTED_SHA256[path], "actual": digest}
        for path, digest in actual.items()
        if digest != PROTECTED_SHA256[path]
    }
    if mismatches:
        raise RuntimeError("Phase 2 protected input drift: " + json.dumps(mismatches, indent=2))
    return actual


def load_base():

    }
    exec(compile(source, namespace["__file__"], "exec"), namespace)

def bilingual(value, lang: str, fallback=""):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key in (lang, "zh" if lang == "zh" else "en", f"text_{lang}"):
            if value.get(key):
                return str(value[key])
    if value is None:
        return fallback
    return str(value)


def first(obj, *names, default=""):
    for name in names:
        if isinstance(obj, dict) and obj.get(name) not in (None, "", []):
            return obj[name]
    return default


def lang_value(obj, root: str, lang: str, fallback=""):
    return first(obj, f"{root}_{lang}", root, default=fallback) if not isinstance(obj.get(root), dict) else bilingual(obj[root], lang, fallback)


def compact(value: str, chars: int, lines: int = 2) -> str:
    value = " ".join(str(value).replace("\n", " ").split())
    limit = chars * lines
    return value if len(value) <= limit else value[: max(1, limit - 1)].rstrip() + "…"


def wrapped(board, value: str, width: int, max_lines: int, lang: str) -> str:
    value = compact(value, width, max_lines)
    if lang == "zh":
        return board.wrap(value, width)
    lines = textwrap.wrap(value, width=width, break_long_words=False)
    return "\n".join(lines[:max_lines])


def state_id(item) -> str:
    return str(first(item, "state_id", "id", "state", "name", default="unknown"))


def state_label(item, lang: str) -> str:
    return str(first(item, f"label_{lang}", f"name_{lang}", "label", "name", default=state_id(item)))


def scenario_summary(sc: dict, lang: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    fs = sc.get("frontstage_summary", {})
    ai = first(fs, f"ai_may_{lang}", default=lang_value(sc, "ai_may", lang))
    human = first(fs, f"human_only_{lang}", default=lang_value(sc, "human_only", lang))
    takeover = first(fs, f"takeover_{lang}", default=lang_value(sc.get("human_takeover", {}), "frontstage_action", lang))
    low = first(fs, f"low_tech_{lang}", default=lang_value(sc, "low_tech_alternative", lang))
    lifecycle = first(fs, f"lifecycle_{lang}", default=lang_value(sc, "lifecycle", lang))
    carrier_block = sc.get("purpose_and_spatial_carrier", {})
    carrier = first(sc, f"carrier_{lang}", default=first(carrier_block, f"carrier_{lang}", default=lang_value(sc, "spatial_carrier", lang)))
    return {
        "ai": str(ai), "human": str(human), "takeover": str(takeover),
        "low": str(low), "lifecycle": str(lifecycle), "carrier": str(carrier),
    }

def list_transitions(protocol: dict):
    machine = protocol.get("shared_state_machine", {})
    transitions = machine.get("transitions", [])
    if isinstance(transitions, dict):
        transitions = [{"transition_id": k, **(v if isinstance(v, dict) else {})} for k, v in transitions.items()]
    return transitions


def adverse_tests(redteam: dict):
    tests = first(redteam, "tests", "red_team_tests", "failure_tests", default=[])
    adverse = []
    for test in tests:
        decision_obj = first(test, "stop_exit_decision", "decision", "result", "status", default="")
        disposition = first(decision_obj, "tabletop_disposition", "disposition", default="") if isinstance(decision_obj, dict) else decision_obj
        disposition = str(disposition).lower()
        if disposition.startswith(("fail", "unknown")) or disposition == "controlled_stop":
            adverse.append(test)
    return tests, adverse

        base["ZH"]["f11"] = ("F11", "运行、接管、申诉、停止与撤场", "共用状态机＋SC10/IM06 唯一首用预检＋反方负结果")
    else:
        base["EN"]["f08"] = ("F08", "Twelve Scenario Protocols: AI Authority + Human Takeover", "12/12 comparable contracts; three flagships carry end-to-end paths")
        base["EN"]["f11"] = ("F11", "Operate, Take Over, Appeal, Stop, and Remove", "Shared lifecycle + SC10/IM06 preflight + retained adverse results")
    page = base["html_page"](lang)
    tests, adverse = adverse_tests(redteam)
    states = protocol.get("shared_state_machine", {}).get("states", [])
    state_count = len(states) if isinstance(states, (list, dict)) else 0
    categories = first(governance, "data_categories", "categories", default=[])
    scenario_profiles = first(governance, "scenario_profiles", "scenarios", default=[])

    if lang == "zh":
        title = "第三期协议判断"

            f"数据治理覆盖 {len(categories)} 类数据、{len(scenario_profiles)} 个场景画像和 {len(protected)} 类等效服务；反方测试 {len(tests)} 项，其中 {len(adverse)} 项保留不通过、停止或 unknown。"
        )

    else:
        title = "Phase 3 protocol judgment"
        body = (
            f"All twelve scenarios share a {state_count}-state lifecycle. Machine contracts constrain AI authority and specify human-only decisions, frontstage notice, Human Takeover, low-tech alternatives, complaint and appeal, logs, retention/deletion, evaluation, and removal. "
            f"Governance covers {len(categories)} data categories, {len(scenario_profiles)} scenario profiles, and {len(protected)} equivalent-service groups; {len(tests)} red-team tests retain {len(adverse)} fail, stop, or unknown outcomes."
        )
        note = "These are design-target operating contracts, not completed legal review, official approval, operator appointment, safety certification, or site verification."
    block = f'<section class="protocol-index" aria-labelledby="phase3-protocol-title"><h2 id="phase3-protocol-title">{html.escape(title)}</h2><p>{html.escape(body)}</p><p class="provisional">{html.escape(note)}</p><p><a href="#scenario-matrix">30s · F08</a> → <a href="#operations-pathway">F11</a></p></section>'
    page = page.replace('<div class="boards">', block + '<div class="boards">', 1)
    page = page.replace('data-metric="green_ratio" data-value="0.123423">≈12%', 'data-metric="green_ratio" data-value="0.247076">≈25%')
    page = page.replace('data-metric="public_space_ratio" data-value="0.073281">≈7%', 'data-metric="public_space_ratio" data-value="0.042599">≈4%')
    page = page.replace('</head>', '<meta name="phase3-protocol-contract" content="12 scenarios; shared lifecycle; human takeover; stop and removal"></head>', 1)
    return page

    FIG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    DRAW_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        tmp = Path(tmp_name)

        base["static_font"](vf, 400, regular)
        base["static_font"](vf, 700, bold)

        html_zh = phase3_visual_html(base, "zh", protocol, governance, redteam)
        html_en = phase3_visual_html(base, "en", protocol, governance, redteam)
        chars = base["all_text"]() + html_zh + html_en + json.dumps({"protocol": protocol, "governance": governance, "redteam": redteam}, ensure_ascii=False)
        reg_woff, bold_woff = tmp / "JZNoto-Regular.woff2", tmp / "JZNoto-Bold.woff2"

        base["subset_woff2"](bold, chars, bold_woff)

        for lang, suffix in (("zh", ""), ("en", ".en")):
            f08 = draw_f08(base, protocol, regular, bold, lang)
            f11 = draw_f11(base, protocol, governance, redteam, regular, bold, lang)
            for image, name in ((f08, f"scenario-matrix{suffix}.png"), (f11, f"operations-pathway{suffix}.png")):
                staged = tmp / name
                image.save(staged, "PNG", optimize=True)

        (VIS_ASSETS / "font-subset.css").write_text(base["font_css"](reg_woff, bold_woff), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

        (VIS_DIR / "index.html").write_text(html_zh, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        (VIS_DIR / "index.en.html").write_text(html_en, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        base["ensure_report_favicon"]()
        base["make_pdfs"](DRAW_DIR, regular, bold, "zh")
        base["make_pdfs"](DRAW_DIR, regular, bold, "en")

    after = assert_protected()
    input_paths = [PROTOCOL_PATH, GOVERNANCE_PATH, REDTEAM_PATH, DELTA_PATH, SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_PATH, BASE_SOURCE_PATH]
    output_hashes = {path: sha256(SUB / path) for path in OUTPUTS}
    tests, adverse = adverse_tests(redteam)
    contract = {
        "schema_version": "phase3-governance-generation-contract-v1",
        "authority": {
            "phase2_frozen_head": "554979e4bc66f21fbdf53e4cde85ed94afe4421c",
            "phase3_scope": "protocols, governance, Human Takeover, red-team, F08/F11, bilingual HTML, and PDFs only",
            "spatial_evidence_changed": False,
            "pdf_reproducibility": base["PDF_REPRODUCIBILITY"],
            "font_reproducibility": base["FONT_REPRODUCIBILITY"],
            "toolchain": toolchain,
        },
        "input_sha256": {str(path.relative_to(SUB)).replace("\\", "/"): sha256(path) for path in input_paths},
        "protected_sha256_before": before,
        "protected_sha256_after": after,
        "output_sha256": output_hashes,
        "consistency": {
            "scenario_ids": [str(first(sc, "scenario_id", "id")) for sc in protocol.get("scenarios", [])],
            "state_ids": [state_id(item) for item in (protocol.get("shared_state_machine", {}).get("states", []) if isinstance(protocol.get("shared_state_machine", {}).get("states", []), list) else [])],
            "flagships": ["SC01", "SC05", "SC10"],
            "single_first_use": "SC10+IM06",
            "data_category_count": len(first(governance, "data_categories", "categories", default=[])),
            "scenario_governance_count": len(first(governance, "scenario_profiles", "scenarios", default=[])),
            "red_team_test_count": len(tests),
            "retained_fail_stop_unknown_count": len(adverse),
            "protected_path_count": len(PROTECTED_SHA256),
            "generated_output_count": len(OUTPUTS),
        },
        "generated_outputs": OUTPUTS,
    }
    CONTRACT_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(contract, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    print(json.dumps(contract["consistency"], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


def check():
    assert_protected()
    missing = [path for path in OUTPUTS if not (SUB / path).is_file()]
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing generated outputs: " + ", ".join(missing))
    contract = load_json(CONTRACT_PATH)
    mismatches = {
        path: {"expected": expected, "actual": sha256(SUB / path)}
        for path, expected in contract.get("output_sha256", {}).items()
        if (SUB / path).is_file() and sha256(SUB / path) != expected
    }
    if mismatches:
        raise RuntimeError("Generated output drift: " + json.dumps(mismatches, indent=2))
    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "outputs": len(OUTPUTS), "protected": len(PROTECTED_SHA256)}, indent=2))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    check() if args.check else generate()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
